# Question 1: # of Listings

## Read the data

```{r read_data}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")

head(listings)
```

## Determine the number of listings

```{r num_listings}
nrow(listings)
```
